steps.message: Done. The root cause: this repo's `immutable_heads()` revset alias was set to `bookmarks()`, so any bookmark (like your local `retry-backoff`) immortalized its entire ancestry, not just `main`. I scoped it to `bookmarks(exact:"main")` instead, which unlocked the rest of the stack while keeping `main` and its history immutable. Then reworded `19cfeaa7` to "handle nonces on retried charges" — jj auto-rebased the two descendants (`retry-backoff` and your working-copy commit).
